questions.title: Which party will receive the largest share of the vote in Berlin's 2026 state election?
questions.background: Berlin is both a city and a German federal state. Its state election determines the composition of its parliament.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Results published by Berlin's election authority or reliable contemporaneous reporting of those results. Resolution : Resolve to the party receiving the highest statewide vote share in Berlin's 2026 state election. Subsequent coalition negotiations and the selection of the mayor do not affect resolution. Accepted Answer Format : The party's name or its standard abbreviation.
questions.current_reasoning: Major new post-Saxony-Anhalt Berlin poll released Sept 11 by Forschungsgruppe Wahlen for ZDF-Politbarometer (field Sept 7-10, n=1,100; DAWUM, DIE ZEIT) puts Die Linke clearly in first at 23% (+2 ahead of CDU at 21%), with AfD sliding to 17%, Greens at 16%, SPD collapsing to 10%, and BSW at 3%. Combined with the Sept 10 Infratest dimap / ARD poll (field Sept 7-9, n=1,527: Linke 21%, CDU 20%, AfD 18%, Greens 16%, SPD 12%), BOTH gold-standard public-broadcaster polls fielded after Saxony-Anhalt now place Die Linke in first place (averaging 22.0% Linke vs 20.5% CDU, 17.5% AfD, 16.0% Greens, 11.0% SPD; all-September recency-weighted average 21.1% Linke, 20.5% CDU, 17.7% AfD, 16.2% Greens, 11.6% SPD). Moreover, fieldwork largely preceded the Sept 9 revelation of criminal investigations into SPD lead candidate Steffen Krach, further depressing SPD, while tens of thousands protested AfD in Berlin on Sept 12 (Al Jazeera). Correlated Student-t (df=7) polling-error simulations (RMSE 2.5-2.9 pts, retaining modest shy-AfD/late-undecided tails) lift Die Linke sharply 0.41 -> 0.50, hold CDU near 0.34 (down 0.01), trim AfD 0.17 -> 0.12 (now 4.5 pts behind Linke with zero Berlin post-Saxony-Anhalt surge), and compress trailing Greens (0.06 -> 0.035) and SPD (0.01 -> 0.005).

questions.title: Which club, if any, will win the La Liga Madrid derby on September 20, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The official La Liga match result, corroborated by reliable news coverage. Resolution : Resolve according to the final score, including stoppage time, of the Madrid derby scheduled for September 20, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : Return the winning club's name. If the match finishes level, return “Draw”.

local_articles.title: Real Madrid’s Kylian Mbappe ends Nike partnership to join Swiss brand On
local_articles.snippet: France captain Kylian Mbappe has signed with Swiss sportswear brand On, ending a long association with Nike that stretches back to the start of his career, the company has announced. “Today, Swiss sportswear brand On announces its entry into football alongside football champion Kylian Mbappe, marking the beginning of the brand’s journey into the world’s biggest sport,” read a company statement on Friday. On also announced that 1998 World Cup winner Thierry Henry had been appointed its football director. The company plans to launch its first football boots next year. “From the beginning, what drew me to On was the opportunity to build something entirely new together that will help shape tomorrow’s game,” said Mbappe. local_articles.title: Kylian Mbappe leaves Nike, signs with On as it forays into football
local_articles.snippet: MADRID – French football star Kylian Mbappe has ended his two-decade-long partnership with Nike and signed with Swiss sportswear brand On, the latest blow for the American brand as newer rivals gain ground in the athletic footwear market. On plans to launch its first football boots in 2027, and also named former French player Thierry Henry as its director of football. On’s US-listed shares were up 5 per cent in pre-market trading. The Roger Federer-backed company is looking for growth in the Americas, which account for more than half of its revenue. On has focused on full-price sales, but has struggled in the region in 2026 amid choppy economic spending. questions.title: Who will win the women's half marathon at the 2026 World Athletics Road Running Championships in Copenhagen?
questions.background: The World Athletics Road Running Championships award an individual world title in the women's half marathon.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official World Athletics race results, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the athlete declared the winner of the individual women's half marathon at the 2026 World Athletics Road Running Championships in Copenhagen when the race results are announced. The team competition does not count. Accepted Answer Format : The winning athlete's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: 2026-09-17 race-week form and arrival update ahead of Sunday's 09:10 CEST women's half marathon in Copenhagen (Athletics Weekly Sept 17, Sports Network Africa Sept 17, FloTrack entry list Sept 15): All top entrants are confirmed intact with zero late withdrawals, and fresh Sept 17 reporting significantly strengthens Agnes Jebet Ngetich's favorite profile—she has arrived in Copenhagen healthy (compressing pre-race DNS risk <72h out) in peak 2026 form across every distance: a 42-second World Cross Country win in January, a 28:58 Lille 10km (#3 all-time), a world-leading 8:08.95 3000m in Monaco in July (establishing elite championship closing speed even in a tactical unpaced race), and back-to-back Valencia 1:03:04 (2024) and 1:03:08 (2025) half marathons (#2 and #3 all-time), with only an over-paced NYC Half fade in March (1:10:25) as a cautionary tail. Conversely, Sports Network Africa notes Lilian Kasait Rengeruk (1:03:32 PB, no 2026 HM SB) set her top marks two years ago in 2024, narrowing her margin over in-form Ethiopian #1 Tsigie Gebreselama (1:04:48 Lisbon win, 2026 SB leader, 1:04:21 PB, 4th in Riga 2023). Multi-scenario fast/tactical race simulations retaining a ~5-7% road-race blow-up/DNS tail lift Agnes Jebet Ngetich 0.46 -> 0.51 (+0.05), trim Lilian Kasait Rengeruk 0.18 -> 0.165 (-0.015), hold Tsigie Gebreselama at 0.14, and trim Ftaw Zeray 0.065 -> 0.055 (1:05:12 Paris PB) and Daisilah Jerono 0.055 -> 0.045 (1:05:21 Berlin PB; top-5 sum = 0.915, leaving 0.085 for Veronica Loleo ~0.035, Baraky Redae, Weini Kelati Frezghi, Esther Chebet, Klara Lukan, and field).

questions.title: Which sector will show the largest year-on-year percentage decline in Iran's official GDP report for March 21–June 20, 2026?
questions.background: Iran is at war with the United States and Israel.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Statistical Center of Iran's GDP figures for March 21–June 20, 2026, publicly reported by September 21, 2026. The answer is the economic sector with the greatest year-on-year percentage contraction among the sectors reported. Resolution Date : 2026-09-21 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the sector's conventional name.
questions.current_reasoning: Key economic data update discovered in Aug 18-21, 2026 reporting (MERO / Naghsh-e-Eghtesad Online): early Spring 2026 (Spring 1405, March 21-June 20, 2026) Iranian GDP figures show headline output contracted just 0.21% YoY, cushioned by +6.5% growth in utilities (heavily subsidized water/electricity/gas rebounding off depressed Spring 1404 blackout base) and +1.46% growth in manufacturing. That directly invalidates Water and electricity (previously 0.12) and sharply downgrades Industry (previously 0.16), removing both from the top 5 while retaining residual probability (~0.06 combined) in case Statistical Center of Iran's final report diverges from preliminary/CBI figures. Meanwhile, Sept 13 Al Jazeera reporting underscores severe wartime contraction in investment, housing, hospitality/dining, and air/sea/overland transit amid 89% August inflation (127% food) and the maritime blockade. Because smaller-weight sectors can suffer deep double-digit contractions consistent with mild -0.21% headline GDP, Construction (already plunging -15.8% in FY 1404 and -33.0% in Q3 1404) rises to #1 at 0.28 (up from 0.22), Oil and gas trims slightly 0.28 -> 0.24 (Hormuz/war disruption offset by mild headline contraction and pre-July-14 blockade timing), Accommodation and food jumps 0.06 -> 0.14 (already -20.3% in Q4 1404 with wartime Nowruz travel wipeout), Transportation and storage enters at 0.10 (airspace/shipping/rail chokepoints), and Agriculture enters at 0.07 (drought/input shock; top-5 sum = 0.83, leaving 0.17 for Industry, Mining, Trade, Real estate, Water/electricity, and other SCI subsectors).
